content:
{'translation': "Although Apple has been trying to keep its distance from former design chief Jony Ive and avoid dragging him into its lawsuit against OpenAI, the company may not be able to stop its former design chief from being pulled into the dispute. Here's why.", 'translation_zh': '雖然蘋果一直試圖與前設計總監Jony Ive保持距離，避免將他牽扯入針對OpenAI的訴訟之中，但這家公司或許無法阻止其前設計主管被拉入這場糾紛。原因如下。'}

{'translation': 'OpenAI has the opportunity to put Apple in a very awkward position.', 'translation_zh': 'OpenAI有機會讓蘋果陷入一個非常尷尬的局面。'}

{'translation': "In its lawsuit accusing OpenAI of stealing trade secrets, Apple has deliberately avoided mentioning Jony Ive. The company he founded, io Products, is the partner working with OpenAI to develop the hardware product at the heart of Apple's allegations.", 'translation_zh': '在其指控OpenAI竊取商業機密的訴訟中，蘋果刻意迴避提及Jony Ive。由他創辦的公司io Products，正是與OpenAI合作開發蘋果指控所涉及核心硬件產品的合作方。'}

{'translation': "The complaint contains a line stating that 'OpenAI and its co-conspirators engaged in organized, institutional misconduct,' mentioning io but describing it only as 'a company co-founded by Mr. Tang and other former Apple executives.' Beyond that, the complaint does not name Ive, Evans Hankey, or any other former Apple executives — it directly accuses only Tang Tan and Chang Liu of wrongdoing.", 'translation_zh': '訴狀中有一句寫道「OpenAI及其同謀從事了有組織的、制度性的不當行為」，當中提及io，但僅將其描述為「由Tang先生及其他前蘋果高層共同創辦的企業」。除此之外，訴狀並無點名Ive、Evans Hankey或任何其他前蘋果高層——僅直接指控Tang Tan和Chang Liu涉嫌不當行為。'}

{'translation': "It's still too early to say whether Ive might take the stand, but it's certainly a possibility — especially if OpenAI decides to use him to embarrass or discomfort Apple.", 'translation_zh': '目前斷言Ive是否可能出庭作證仍言之尚早，但這確實存在可能性——尤其是在OpenAI決定利用他來令蘋果感到尷尬或難堪的情況下。'}

{'translation': 'This would put Apple in an unusually delicate position. Since leaving in 2019, Ive has publicly maintained a respectful stance toward Apple, with his public appearances and interviews carefully orchestrated.', 'translation_zh': '這將令蘋果陷入一個異常微妙的處境。自2019年離職以來，Ive在公開場合一直保持對蘋果的尊重態度，他的公開亮相和訪問均經過精心安排。'}

{'translation': "These activities include appearing alongside Laurene Powell Jobs and ongoing involvement with the Steve Jobs Archive. Earlier this year, Ive personally wrote a letter for the archive's 'Letters to a Young Creator' series, reflecting on his years working with Jobs.", 'translation_zh': '這些活動包括與Laurene Powell Jobs一同亮相，以及持續參與Steve Jobs Archive。今年較早時候，Ive更親自為該檔案項目的「Letters to a Young Creator」撰寫了一封信，回顧他與Jobs共事的歲月。'}

{'translation': 'Apple appears to have reciprocated this goodwill, carefully adjusting its stance on several controversial decisions made during his tenure, including the MacBook butterfly keyboard. This attempt to keep its distance from Ive in the lawsuit is also in line with that approach.', 'translation_zh': '蘋果方面似乎也回應了這份善意，謹慎地調整了對其在任期間若干具爭議決定的立場，包括MacBook的蝴蝶鍵盤。而此次試圖在訴訟中與Ive保持距離，亦符合同一取態。'}

{'translation': "However, once the case enters the discovery phase, Apple won't have full control over who gets pulled in. Given Ive's role in founding io Products and overseeing the related hardware project, OpenAI could argue that he has relevant knowledge about the product development process, the information accessible to the team, and whether Apple trade secrets were used.", 'translation_zh': '然而一旦案件進入證據開示階段，蘋果便無法完全控制誰會被牽扯其中。鑑於Ive在創立io Products及監督相關硬件項目中的角色，OpenAI或會主張他對產品的開發過程、團隊可接觸的資料，以及是否有蘋果商業機密被使用等方面，均具備相關知情。'}

{'translation': "Apple could then face the awkward prospect of questioning Ive on the stand, challenging his testimony, or trying to undermine the credibility of the executive who shaped many of the company's most iconic products.", 'translation_zh': '屆時蘋果可能面對一個尷尬的局面：在庭上質問Ive、質疑其證詞，或試圖削弱這位塑造了公司多款最具代表性產品的高層之可信性。'}

{'translation': "This wouldn't be the first time Ive has appeared in litigation involving Apple. Back in 2012, he gave a deposition in Apple's patent lawsuit against Samsung, answering questions about Apple's design process and early iPhone and iPad prototypes.", 'translation_zh': '這並非Ive首次在涉及蘋果的訴訟中出庭。早在2012年，他在蘋果與三星的專利訴訟中接受取證，就蘋果的設計流程以及早期iPhone和iPad原型回答提問。'}

{'translation': 'However, testifying for the opposing side could damage the delicate relationship he has maintained with Apple — and if Ive feels he has been dragged into the dispute for no good reason simply to give his former employer an advantage, it could even cause friction with OpenAI.', 'translation_zh': '然而，為對方出庭作證或會損害他一直與蘋果維持的微妙關係——若Ive認為自己被無端捲入糾紛，只為讓前僱主取得優勢，甚至可能與OpenAI產生摩擦。'}

{'translation': 'Do you think Jony Ive will be pulled into this lawsuit? Let us know in the comments.', 'translation_zh': '你認為Jony Ive會否被牽扯入這場訴訟？歡迎在留言區告訴我們你的看法。'}
